in_marathi.name: Brihadish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brihadish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brihadish is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Brihat', meaning 'extensive, large, or wide'. The suffix '-ish' denotes the one who possesses or rules over something. In Hindu mythology, Brihadish is considered the lord of the universe or the supreme deity, representing creation, preservation, and destruction.
